color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Legend
Pale blue: API component; blue: supporting container; grey: external system.
Arrows show calls/dependencies; labels are in the full C3. Nested groups identify module ownership.
SQL triggers and pg_cron execute inside PostgreSQL. Legacy HS256 uses a backend secret instead of JWKS.
